title: Story premise EDU009: The Mirror-Tile Repair
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (basic math). Hook: Where would this tile land if the page folded? Takeaway/theme: Reflection preserves distance to the mirror line on the opposite side.
description: A mosaic maker must repair a reflected pattern, but copies a tile to the same side of the mirror line. Folding the drawing makes paired positions touch and reveals the missing tile location.
